name: askwearables-selfhost
description: AskWearables, self-host edition: one Cloudflare Worker that answers AI agents' questions about your own wearable data.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

MASTER_KEY.description: 32 random bytes, base64. Encrypts your health data at rest. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and **keep a copy somewhere safe**: losing or changing it makes stored data unreadable.

OWNER_SETUP_TOKEN.description: A one-time token that opens the owner setup page at `/setup?token=...`. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 24`. It stops working once the owner passkey exists.

DB.description: D1 database for the control plane: the owner, passkeys, sessions, connected agents and their grants, API keys. No health data.

OAUTH_KV.description: KV namespace for OAuth clients, authorization codes and tokens (stored as hashes).

USER_VAULT.description: Durable Object (SQLite) that holds your health data, computes answers, and keeps the receipt log and daily budgets.

AI.description: Workers AI, used to turn an agent's question into a query (`@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`, falling back to `@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b`). Billed to your account as Workers AI usage.

PLANNER_MODEL.description: Workers AI model that plans questions. Leave the default unless you know you want another.

PLANNER_FALLBACK_MODEL.description: Second Workers AI model, tried when the first is unavailable or returns an invalid plan.
